notes: Account: large sell-side research group building a knowledge search portal for equity research and analyst notes.
Primary ask: RAG with high-quality embeddings + reranking to surface most-relevant analyst notes and citations.
Scale: expect initial index 20M documents -> ~60M vectors; long-term target 100M+ vectors (daily ingest from research pipeline).
Preferred deployment: Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) to guarantee tail latency and predictable cost; Private control plane or VPC for sensitive datasets.
Security: must integrate with customer KMS (HSM-backed key rotation), SSO/SAML, audit logs retained 7+ years for compliance; strict EU/US residency controls per fund mandates.
Latency targets: p50 < 50ms, p95 < 120ms for embeddings+rerank end-to-end (client -> response), aim for 99th < 200ms on dedicated nodes.
Cost target: internal goal ~$0.005-0.01 per query at 100 QPS with batching/kv-caching; very cost sensitive for archival-heavy queries.
Model preferences: open-model embeddings (vector size/ops tunable), candidate reranker (lightweight cross-encoder on quantized weights) with automatic fallback to cheaper variant under load.
Routing: need smart routing by region (NA/EU) and fallback to lower-cost model when dedicated pool saturated.
Quote from CTO: "We need predictable tail latency and auditable key control — can't have black-box endpoints for primary research workflows."
Probe: asked for benchmark with our dataset (500K doc sample) + projection for 50M vector index; requested SLOs and cost sensitivity scenarios.
Security review status: vendor questionnaire started; next: KMS integration workshop w/ security team.
Commercial: procurement expects a dedicated-reserved offer (12–24mo) plus a professional services block for onboarding/ingest pipelines.
Internal notes: AE to push committed usage discount; SE to model autoscaling policy that keeps tail latencies under SLO while controlling token spend.
